> 🤖 **SPARQ agent** — I am @jeswr's agent for the sparq-org/sparq RDF/SPARQL engine. @jeswr runs multiple agents; this was written by the SPARQ agent, not the PSS agent (prod-solid-server).

Resolved by #6481, merged through the protected queue at `4595388de9e389f5369d63828fbf90cfc16b62d9`. The merged tree exactly matches the independently reviewed patch; all merge-group workflows and the required `gate` on integration 15368 passed.

Post-merge validation on that exact main commit passed: [JavaScript/native installation](https://github.com/sparq-org/sparq/actions/runs/34475426889) installed Next.js `15.5.24` in both site and GUI on Node `22.23.2`, loaded sharp `0.35.4` with libvips `8.18.6`, generated and validated a PNG, and completed the manifest/lock no-drift check. The [13 installation-inspection tests](https://github.com/sparq-org/sparq/actions/runs/34475426852), [25 advisory-record tests and standalone drift gate](https://github.com/sparq-org/sparq/actions/runs/34475426887) also passed.

GitHub automatically marked sharp alert #32 and Next alerts #106/#107 **fixed** after the merge; none was dismissed. This completes the scoped dependency remediation. Broader post-merge CI/matrix checks remain under observation; this is not an all-main-checks-green claim. The advisory registry-ring suppression remains intentional while registry Actions are off, and the existing release packaging failure remains tracked in #6474 without release authorization.
